ezekiel.9.p1.b1.text: Draw near, O executioners of the city, each with a weapon of destruction in hand.

ezekiel.9.p1.b2.text: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the Upper Gate, which faces north … With them was another man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. And they came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

ezekiel.9.p1.b3.text: Then the glory of the God of Israel rose from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple.

ezekiel.9.p1.b4.text: And He called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side.

ezekiel.9.p1.b5.text: Go throughout the city of Jerusalem … and put a mark on the foreheads of the men sighing and groaning over all the abominations committed there.

ezekiel.9.p2.b1.text: Follow him through the city and start killing; do not show pity or spare anyone!

ezekiel.9.p2.b2.text: … but do not go near anyone who has the mark.

ezekiel.9.p2.b3.text: So they went out and began killing throughout the city.

ezekiel.9.p2.b4.text: While they were killing, I was left alone. And I fell facedown and cried out,

ezekiel.9.p2.b5.text: Oh, Lord GOD, when You pour out Your wrath on Jerusalem, will You destroy the entire remnant of Israel?

ezekiel.9.p2.b6.text: The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great. … For they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD does not see.’

ezekiel.9.p2.b7.text: I have done as You commanded.
